Snickers Caramel Crunch Ice Cream Cone #shorts #food #Recipe  FULL RECIPE BELOW👇🏿 Ingredients Chocolate Shell 16 ounces milk chocolate or chocolate melting wafers, chopped Caramel Crunch Ice Cream 2 cups cold heavy whipping cream 1 can (14 ounces) sweetened condensed milk ½ cup caramel sauce ½ cup roasted peanuts, roughly chopped ½ cup chopped milk chocolate or chopped Snickers bars Instructions Make the Chocolate Shells Place unopened piping bags inside large cups, such as Stanley cups or other tall drinking cups. This will help the bags hold their cone shape. Melt the chopped chocolate in a microwave-safe bowl in 20-second intervals, stirring between each interval until completely smooth. Pour a portion of the melted chocolate into each piping bag. Carefully move and spread the chocolate around the inside of each bag, creating an even chocolate layer. Place the bags, still supported by the cups, in the freezer for 10 minutes or until the chocolate is firm. Repeat with a second layer of melted chocolate. Freeze again until completely firm. Make the Caramel Crunch Ice Cream Add the cold heavy whipping cream to a large mixing bowl. Whip with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form. Be careful not to overmix. Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk until evenly combined. Fold in the caramel sauce, chopped peanuts, and chopped chocolate or Snickers pieces.
